prContext.title: Add candidate ID types
prContext.description: Introduces branded types for candidate IDs to prevent mixing with other ID types.
prContext.instructions: Review for TypeScript type safety and patterns.

groundTruth.description: toCandidateId does no validation — any string can be cast, defeating the purpose of branded types. Should validate UUID format.
moveCandidate takes branded types but internal implementation may still accept plain strings via implicit any. Function body should be shown and validated.
Branded type uses intersection with string — nominal typing is better achieved with unique symbol or abstract class for stronger encapsulation.

reviewer_comments.what: toCandidateId casts without validation — any string works.
reviewer_comments.why: This defeats the safety purpose of branded types. Should validate UUID format.

reviewer_comments.what: Consider using a unique symbol for the brand instead of string intersection.
reviewer_comments.why: Stronger nominal typing prevents accidental structural compatibility.

rounds.reviewer_summary: Validation is blocking. Symbol brand is recommended.

implementer_responses.updated_code: if (!/^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/i.test(id)) throw new Error('Invalid CandidateId'); return id as CandidateId;

implementer_responses.content: Symbol brands are verbose in TS. String intersection is the standard pattern in our codebase.

verdict.summary: Validation looks good. String intersection is acceptable per codebase convention.

issue_identification.rationale: Found 2 of 3 bugs (validation, brand type). Missed implementation body check. Level 3-4.

prioritization.rationale: Validation flagged as blocking. Type suggestion as non-blocking. Good triage. Level 3-4.

revision_evaluation.rationale: Verified UUID regex. Accepted pushback on brand type with reasoning. Level 3-4.

reasoning_quality.rationale: Concrete rationale for validation and nominal typing. Level 3-4.

ai_direction.rationale: Suggested regex validation and symbol brand — actionable. Level 3-4.
